notes.title: 'Apex Heroines' First Release FAQ
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636549/595af0ab88dfbe7c28a1d0919ebf67418c5e1214.jpg

Q: When will the game release and what is the price?
A: It will be released on Steam globally on January 19th at 10:00, priced at $20 with a 20% discount for the first week.
 
Q: How much content is in the launch version of the game?
A: The amount of content in the launch version of the game is as follows:
-5 large levels + 2 major trial levels and 1 challenge mode
-6 controllable characters with different styles
-5 main weapons with varying degrees of difficulty
-10 Bosses with unique mechanics + a variety of enemies with different characteristics
-Advanced Challenge (Arena) mode to challenge all the bosses one on one.
-Dozens of beautiful fashions in different styles  
We hope to give enough rich and sincere content so that everyone can experience this game!
 
Q: What languages does the game support?
A: The launch version is available in all regions, and also supports fourteen national language texts such as Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English and Japanese.
 
Configuration Information
Q: What systems does the game support and what is the minimum configuration?
A: Support for Windows systems, in order to ensure the smoothness of the game, the minimum configuration of Windows is recommended to be Intel Core i3/4 GB RAM/GTX 520 and above.
 
Q: What is the recommended resolution for the game?
A：Recommended to run in 2560*1440 (2K) resolution, up to support 4K/120HZ.
 
Q: Is the game compatible with game controller and Steam Deck?
A: The game is fully compatible with game controller, in-game settings can be freely switched between keyboard and mouse or controller, and can be customized to adjust the key position. The game can also run smoothly at 60 fps on Steam Deck.
 
Q: Does the game support multiplayer?
A: The launch version only supports single-player, and there is no local or online content for the time being.
 
Other questions:
 
Q: Can the key obtained from various activities be used in the game?
A: The key can be used in the PC version of the game, and you can download and play after activating the game.
 
Q: How can I contact the official staff for feedback suggestions?
A: You can contact us through the Steam community channel. 

Learn more about this game

notes.title: [Trial Version] 11.21 Fixes and Updates
notes.content:
Hello players!
Since the opening of the trial version of "Apex Heroines", we have received positive feedback on the trial version, and the details of the existing updates and fixes are as follows, and we hope that we can solve the problems you are concerned about~ Thank you once again for your attention and support for our game!

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed the bug that the props bar is displayed in the [Battle UI].
2. Fixed the bug that the Combo is interrupted under the invincible star state.

Optimization
1. Optimized the distribution of monsters in the quests of [Mirage World - Beautiful Island].
2. Optimized the jumping rhythm of Aurora in the main city.
3. Optimized the character form in the login interface, changed the position of Godly Might and Thunder, and changed Godly Might's Pose.
4. Optimized the button display logic of the login interface, before the player passes the prelude chapter, there is no longer a button to continue the game in the login interface.
5. Removed [Shield Soldier] from the 4th Zone of the prologue, and reduced 1 wave of enemies.
6. Removed Zone 6 from the Prologue, along with the appearance of the Self-Destructing Robot (3 waves of enemies), and replaced it with a Diffusion Trap + Gold Reward.
7. Removed [Pulser] from Zone 7 and reduced 1 wave of enemies.
8. Reduced the third wave of enemies in Zone 2, 3, 5, and 8 of the Prologue by 1 enemy each.
9. Optimized the speed of the mouse wheel on the [Foster Panel] page.

Added
1. Added a pop-up panel for the end of the trial after returning to the main city after a mission in [Mirage World - Mishima].
2. Added upgrade option for [Foster Panel]: Gold Sucking Range.
3. Added the trial version of [Training Level - Mishima].
